name: BTC vs SPY Drawdown Episodes
description: Compares Bitcoin and S&P 500 (SPY) drawdown episodes over a 3-year daily period. Includes an underwater chart showing drawdown depth/duration for both assets, a summary table with max drawdown, average drawdown, episode counts (below -10%), and longest drawdown duration, plus a normalized price chart (base 100) for context.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC VS SPY DRAWDOWN EPISODES
# =============================================================================
# Compares Bitcoin and S&P 500 drawdown episodes over a 3-year daily period.
#
# Charts:
#   1. Underwater chart: BTC and SPY drawdowns as area fills
#   2. Summary table: max DD, avg DD, episodes below -10%, longest duration
#   3. Normalized price chart (base 100) for context
#
# Dataset:
#   - market_data_source (SPY-Stocks, 1D)
#   - common_crypto_pairs (BTCUSD)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# BTC via reference
btc_o, btc_h, btc_l, btc_c, btc_v, btc_vw, btc_n = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.BTCUSD)()
btc = ffill(btc_c)

# --- Drawdown Calculations ---
# SPY drawdown from rolling peak
spy_max = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(close)
spy_dd = (close - spy_max) / spy_max

# BTC drawdown from rolling peak
btc_max = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(btc)
btc_dd = (btc - btc_max) / btc_max

# --- Summary Statistics ---
# Max drawdown (deepest point)
spy_max_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(spy_dd)
btc_max_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(btc_dd)

# Average drawdown
spy_avg_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spy_dd)
btc_avg_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(btc_dd)

# Episode counting: number of times drawdown crosses below -10%
spy_below_10 = spy_dd < -0.10
btc_below_10 = btc_dd < -0.10

# Detect new episode starts: was above -10% yesterday, below today
spy_prev_above = (spy_dd >> 1) >= -0.10
spy_new_episode = spy_below_10 and spy_prev_above
btc_prev_above = (btc_dd >> 1) >= -0.10
btc_new_episode = btc_below_10 and btc_prev_above

# Cumulative count of episodes
spy_episode_count = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(spy_new_episode)
btc_episode_count = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(btc_new_episode)

# Longest drawdown duration (consecutive days in drawdown, dd < 0)
spy_in_dd = spy_dd < 0
btc_in_dd = btc_dd < 0
spy_streak = streak_length(direction=StreakDirection.up)(spy_in_dd)
btc_streak = streak_length(direction=StreakDirection.up)(btc_in_dd)
spy_longest_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(spy_streak)
btc_longest_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(btc_streak)

# --- Normalized Price (Base 100) ---
spy_first = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(close)
btc_first = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(btc)
spy_norm = close / spy_first * 100
btc_norm = btc / btc_first * 100

# --- Chart 1: Underwater Drawdown Chart ---
bar_ts = index()

xy_lines(
    title='BTC vs SPY Underwater Drawdowns',
    category='1. Drawdown Comparison',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='Drawdown from Peak',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='0%')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Bitcoin', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='S&P 500 (SPY)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, btc_dd, spy_dd)

# --- Chart 2: Summary Table ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Drawdown Episode Summary',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Max Drawdown', 'Avg Drawdown', 'Episodes Below -10%', 'Longest DD (Days)'],
        col_headers=['Bitcoin', 'S&P 500 (SPY)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Drawdown Comparison',
    order=1
)(btc_dd, spy_dd, btc_dd, spy_dd, btc_episode_count, spy_episode_count, btc_longest_dd, spy_longest_dd)

# --- Chart 3: Normalized Price Chart ---
xy_lines(
    title='BTC vs SPY Normalized Price (Base 100)',
    category='2. Price Context',
    area=False,
    y_axis_label='Normalized Price',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    log_scale=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=100, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Start (100)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Bitcoin', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='S&P 500 (SPY)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, btc_norm, spy_norm)
